content: Chrome DevTools MCP (Google) optimizes for debugging/performance analysis (console errors, network, perf traces) with more tools (26) than Playwright MCP (21) but is Chrome-only. Playwright MCP optimizes for driving/asserting flows across browsers reliably. For QA flow testing (forms, navigation, assertions) Playwright MCP is the better primary driver; Chrome DevTools MCP is a good complementary tool when console/network errors need root-causing.
